payload.title: File:Laueropterus vitriolus (holotype, pitting).png
payload.credit_html: "A new early monofenestratan pterosaur from the Mörnsheim Formation of southern Germany"
payload.description_html: Close up of damage to the humerus and other elements of the Laueropterus vitriolus holotype .The image shows where the iron has leeched away, and holes have formed in the otherwise well-preserved elements. Scale bar = 20 mm.
